acceptance: MySqlWireLifecycleMixin.get_query_plan returns None on exception and logs warning
FabricWarehouseAdapter.get_query_plan returns None on exception and logs warning
QuestDBAdapter.get_query_plan returns None on exception and logs warning
Failure in get_query_plan records reason='explain_failed' instead of reason='parse_error' in result_capture.py
Unit tests verify None return and clean failure classification across all three adapters
context: Adversarial audit finding QPC-DEF-03. mysql_wire.py, fabric_warehouse.py, and questdb.py returned error strings ('Failed to get query plan: ...') instead of None, which bypassed the falsy check in result_capture.py and was passed to parsers, misclassifying database EXPLAIN failures as parse errors.
description: Eliminate error strings as plan data in MySqlWireLifecycleMixin, FabricWarehouseAdapter, and QuestDBAdapter by logging exceptions and returning None instead of formatted error strings, ensuring EXPLAIN failures record as explain_failed rather than parse_error.
